n: micro:bit Science exploration PD course and projects
t: A free teacher course and project list for science experiments with the micro:bit.
steps: Open the course on Thinkific and check the sign up steps.
Watch the short videos and download the worksheets and code.
Gather micro:bit boards for each group.
Open MakeCode in a browser and load the ready made code.
Try one experiment, such as the environment exploration, before class.
Choose a project from the list of more than 40.
